section_summary.extract_value: This section details a within-subject visual search Latent Inhibition (LI) task. Participants viewed displays with 20 figures, identifying a target among distractors by pressing left or right arrow keys based on its screen position. The task involved a preexposure phase with constant target and distractors, followed by a test phase with four trial types, including conditions where targets and distractors were new or swapped from preexposure. The dependent measure was the mean of individual median response time values, with the critical comparison being the difference between preexposure and non-pre-exposure conditions to reflect LI strength.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire text content of the section describes the LI Task, its methodology, phases, trial types, and dependent measures.
